parameters.content:
## CRM · Ops Agent (Lesson 5.9)
Every Monday at 07:00. An AI Agent with READ-ONLY tools (search companies, contacts, deals and activities; get the pipeline and properties; get last quarter's won and lost deals) plus ONE write tool, propose_change, which only adds a row to the Supabase crm_proposals table.
The agent proposes; Tolu approves or rejects each proposal on Telegram; a SEPARATE executor workflow applies approved rows from a fixed allow-list. It can read anything but change nothing.

Credentials: Header Auth "HubSpot read-only" (Name Authorization, Value Bearer + the token of a SECOND private app, "n8n CRM Ops (read-only)", with read scopes only) on every HubSpot tool; OpenAI; Postgres (Supabase); Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_PROPOSE_CHANGE_WORKFLOW_ID, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

## Supabase tables
-- Run once in Supabase
create table crm_proposals (
  id bigserial primary key, created_at timestamptz default now(),
  action text, target_ids jsonb, details jsonb, evidence text,
  expected_effect text, reversible boolean,
  status text default 'proposed', -- proposed | approved | rejected | executed | blocked | failed
  decided_by text, decided_at timestamptz,
  before_values jsonb, result text, executed_at timestamptz);
create table score_weights (id bigserial primary key,
  name text, value numeric, evidence text, at timestamptz default now());
alter table customers add column if not exists crm_contact_id text;
alter table customers add column if not exists crm_deal_id text;

Create a Postgres credential with your Supabase database connection details and select it in every Postgres node.

parameters.query: select action, target_ids, details, expected_effect, result, executed_at from crm_proposals where status = 'executed' and executed_at > now() - interval '8 days';

options.systemMessage:
Find problems in data, pipeline, score and adoption. Propose only actions on the allowed list, each with evidence. Never propose deleting, changing a stage, messaging customers or changing permissions.

Allowed list (propose_change action): merge_companies (same verified domain), bulk_update_property (clean dropdown values in bulk), create_task (for a deal's owner), require_field (make a field required at a stage), score_weight (a new weight, tested on last quarter first).
Check: Data - duplicate companies and contacts, empty required fields, values outside the dropdowns (IG, insta). Pipeline - deals stuck past 14 days in a stage, deals with no owner or next step, stages nobody uses. Score - did last quarter's buyers score 65 or more? If not, the score needs re-calibrating. Adoption - who logged activity this week, and whose deals have none.
You can read everything and change nothing. Every proposal needs target_ids, details, evidence (counts and record IDs) and expected_effect.
Start with what last week's approved changes achieved, then end with a five-line health report: Data, Pipeline, Score, Adoption, Proposals made.
